create_token_block_dataset: create a TokenBlockDataset to break a token dataset into fixed-size blocks with configurable break modes
build_slice_indices: build slice indices arrays for efficient block indexing using the static _build_slice_indices method
get_token_block_item: get a token block item by index with optional source and past target tensors for training
prefetch_dataset_blocks: prefetch underlying dataset indices for a set of block indices to improve data loading performance
review_token_block_break_modes: review the TokenBlockDataset class and its break modes including none, complete, complete_doc, and eos
